entries.clue: Bottle of sherry or a tin of shortbread, handed to whoever holds the right number
Coiled drinking straw a butterfly unrolls to reach the sweetness in a flower
Dark evergreen climber whose late flowers feed insects well into November
Parson's house, whose big lawn is lent for the afternoon once a year
Pink, sightless crew member dangled as bait to bring the gulls down
Family name of the crooked car dealer and his bingo-playing wife
Top rank of the peerage, held by the man with hundreds of dirty windows
Iced and filled sponge on the home baking stall, sold by the slice or whole
Old punishment frame gripping the ankles, revived at fetes for throwing wet sponges
Naval rank borrowed by the red-banded butterfly that arrives from Europe
